dataset_provenance: Cross-domain training. PlantVillage (controlled lab) + PlantDoc (CC BY 4.0, in-the-wild) + PlantTom (CC BY 4.0, deduplicated tomato-leaf train images) mapped onto the original 38-class PlantVillage label space. The held-out test split is unchanged. See ml/crop_health/evaluation/planttom_dedupe_report.json and cross_domain_results.json for provenance.
notes: Field-robust model trained with cross-domain evaluation. In-domain lab accuracy is reported separately from in-the-wild accuracy; the app must keep presenting results as screening support, not a definitive diagnosis.
